reddit.title: Introducing the New Materials System in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update to our building mechanics! Instead of hiding resource costs behind a single chip, each build tile now displays a detailed **Materials** sheet. You can easily see what you have stored versus what you need, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change makes planning your colony much easier. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Exciting Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We’ve revamped the way you manage resources in Provincia! Each build tile now features a **Materials** control that displays a comprehensive list of what you have stored versus what you need. This means you can easily plan your builds without any confusion. Check out the details and see how this will improve your gameplay experience: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
